system.description: A neurobooster favored among hackers and knowledge workers, Window augments the user's focus and mental reaction speed at the cost of distracting them from their terrestrial surroundings. A Window user can trade their Move action to gain a bonus Main Action that can only be used for cyberspace actions. Each time this is done in a scene, the user gains one System Strain. One dose lasts for one scene. Heal skill required: None.
